        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TblDynamicPivot_SCP0081_COLUMN') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #TblDynamicPivot_SCP0081_COLUMN;

		SELECT    A.COLUMN_NAME AS COL

		INTO    #TblDynamicPivot_SCP0081_COLUMN

						B.PROGRAM_ID = A.PROGRAM_ID

					AND B.COLUMN_NAME = A.COLUMN_NAME
					AND B.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C'

				AND A.LINE_ID       = B.LINE_ID
